integrity: Analytic all-size proof given, with finite exact and numerical spot checks distinguished from proof. Self-review only; no independently performed audit or mathematical priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the unmodified Crank–Nicolson step for the isotropic nearest-neighbor Laplacian on square periodic n by n discrete tori, n >= 3; no Dirichlet, anisotropic, nonlinear, nonnormal or floating-point claim. Historical equivalence, particularly for incompletely accessible periodic-diffusion literature, remains possible.
title: Sharp Crank–Nicolson positivity thresholds on square discrete tori
